title: Renewal & QBR tidbits — Apr 16 2026
content:
Quick brain dump for today — mix of prep notes, reminders, and tiny action items. Not polished; use this to pull slides/asks for QBRs and renewal nudges.

TODAY'S TOP PRIORITIES (Apr 16)
- Quick outreach to Atlas Health (renewal) — confirm exec attendee for 4/28 QBR. If no, push to 5/5.
- Draft 3-slide summary for Nimbus Apps QBR: performance gains (p95 latency drop), cost delta after caching, recommended next steps.
- Follow-up on CS-4212 (Orchid Labs support flow) — unresolved SSO regression, needs eng triage.

ATLAS HEALTH — renewal (M+6 months)
- Renewal window: June 1 renewal target (account committed to Dedicated).
- Current health: medium — good adoption on embeddings, some production errors last week (session cache mismatch).
- Notes to ask in QBR:
  * 'What saved you most since we optimized batching?' -> show token-cost before/after and p95 numbers.
  * Exec ask: business impact metric (time-to-insight for clinical notes). Need a 1-slide example.
  * Risk flags: security review still open (KMS integration). Where is audit doc? (linked_artifacts has Confluence).
- Immediate actions:
  * Maya to ping security about KMS timeline (target EOD Tue).
  * I will prep cost/latency graph (console export + small table).
  * Slack: post snippet to #cs-atlas with proposed dates for exec 4/28 or 5/5.

NIMBUS APPS — QBR prep (Apr 23)
- Win: Eng rolled quantization recommendation; 12% token-cost reduction in dev workload. Need to confirm in prod sampling.
- Slide plan (3 slides):
  1) "Where we started" — baseline latency/cost numbers (generate from console).
  2) "What changed" — model variant + quantization + caching effects (call out Redwood Optimize suggestions).
  3) "Next steps / ask" — propose dedicated pool sizing for peak windows, 2-week canary.
- Action items:
  * Export token usage for last 30 days (console export -> csv) — assigned to me.
  * Ask Solutions Eng for short demo of canary rollout (request SRE/SE time). Linked PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/canary-rollout-proto/pull/58

ORCHID LABS — support follow-ups
- Ticket CS-4212: SSO regression on private deployment when session durations > 12h. Repro steps in ticket, blocked on infra change.
- Quick workaround: recommend short-term token rotation + session refresh client-side. Put steps in reply.
- If infra change not ETA'd by EOW, escalate to infra on-call (pager) and copy Legal for implications.

GENERAL QBR CHECKLIST (what I need to pull together)
- Customer one-pager (one-sentence summary of changes since last QBR).
- Top metrics: monthly tokens, p50/p95 latency, 99.9th failure rate, cost per 1K tokens.
- 2 customer success stories / feature wins (quotes if possible).
- Open risks & mitigation: security, infra regressions, licensing/usage spikes.
- Concrete asks: capacity commit, new feature access, professional services hours.
- Slides: keep under 10, audience = technical + exec.

TODOS (quick list)
- [ ] Prepare Atlas Health cost vs latency CSV + 2-line exec summary (due 2026-04-18) — owner: Zachary.
- [ ] Confirm Atlas exec attendee or propose alternate date (due 2026-04-17) — owner: Maya.
- [ ] Export Nimbus token usage + annotate with quantization windows (due 2026-04-20) — owner: Zachary.
- [ ] Reply to CS-4212 with workaround + escalate if no ETA (due 2026-04-16) — owner: Noah.
- [ ] Draft QBR agenda template for April set (upload to Confluence) — owner: Zachary.

NOTES TO SELF
- Keep screenshots from Console minimal; prefer numbers/tables for execs.
- When asking for Dedicated capacity, call out peak hour window and cost tradeoff explicitly.
- Use Redwood Optimize recommendations slide: "predicted cost saving" vs actuals. Pull sample from product team if available.
- Remember to mention fallback policy for outages: region fallback + model variant fallback — customers care.

UNRESOLVED QUESTIONS
- Atlas KMS: final sign-off date? (security contact Maya).
- Nimbus: is the production dataset sampling representative? Need Product to confirm.
- Orchid Labs: if infra change required, what's the earliest maintenance window to patch private deployment?

SLACK/MEETING REFERENCES
- Slack threads: #cs-atlas (live), #cs-nimbus (archived), #cs-orchid (pinned ticket CS-4212).
- Calendar invites: Atlas QBR proposed 2026-04-28T16:00-17:00 PDT (pending).
- Jira: CS-4212, CS-4340 (Nimbus cost review), CS-4401 (Atlas renewal paperwork).

FINAL QUICK HANDOFF (if I get pulled into incident)
- Whoever owns Atlas slide set: keep 1 slide for action items and 1 for renewal asks. If pulled, Maya will present exec slide.
- If Orchid needs immediate patch, copy Legal + infra on escalation thread.

---
Tiny gratitude note: coffee first. Then spreadsheet exports.

(end of scratchpad)
